# k3d_context (Data Source)

Reads the kubeconfig context of a k3d cluster, or the current context of a kubeconfig, without contacting the Kubernetes API. Use `k3d_cluster` to also get credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k3d_context" "main" {
  cluster = "demo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster` (String) Cluster to read from. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster reached directly and not through Docker. It is stored in Terraform state.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the context's cluster entry.
- `host` (String) Kubernetes API URL.
- `id` (String) The context name.
- `name` (String) Context name, such as `k3d-demo`.
- `namespace` (String) Default namespace of the context, if any.
- `user_name` (String) Name of the context's user entry.
